title: Study Template
description: Machine-readable template for a published study design. Templates are parameterized encodings of citable designs that instantiate into valid protocols (FR-TPL-1). The protocol layer is untouched: templates are protocol generators, one level above study-as-code.

templateVersion.description: Schema version of this template document. Consumers branch on it, never guess (FR-PROT-2 discipline, extended to templates).

templateId.description: Stable, never-renumbered identifier for this template (e.g., 'metr-rct-v1').

description.description: One-paragraph explanation of what this template encodes.

source.description: Mandatory citation(s) for the design this template encodes. Array of paper references that ground this template.

paperRef.description: Canonical paper reference (arxiv:..., doi:..., or corpus:...).

role.description: Role of this paper in the template (e.g., 'primary-design', 'statistical-method', 'measure-validation').

designType.description: Design classification from Stol & Fitzgerald's ABC study-strategy vocabulary (field/lab/sample). Taxonomy ensures templates are classified in the field's own terms.

dataPath.description: Which data collection path this template supports: 'live' (instrumented sessions), 'curated' (pre-existing datasets), or 'either'.

parameters.description: Configurable parameters for this template. Each parameter has a type, optional default, and a rationale explaining its purpose.

default.description: Default value for this parameter. A 'conditions' parameter defaults to an array of arm names; scalar parameters default to a scalar.

rationale.description: Methodological rationale for this parameter's existence.

measures.description: Measures this template prescribes, each mapping to instruments + data elements. The 'caution' field surfaces known validity threats or methodological cautions.

leg.description: Which instrument leg this measure uses: 'cognitive' (overlay), 'behavioral' (telemetry), 'static' (code metrics), 'agent' (transcripts).

description.description: Human-readable description of what this measure captures.

elements.description: Specific data elements captured by this measure.

caution.description: Named validity threat or methodological caution associated with this measure.

cite.description: Paper reference that validates or defines this measure.

instruments.description: Derived instrument configurations (FR-PROT-4) for this design, per condition. This is a template for the protocol's instruments section.

statisticalPlan.description: The statistical plan encoded by this template (FR-TPL-2). This is the differentiator: each template binds concrete statistics to its design.

perRQ.description: Statistical formulation per research question slot.

outcome.description: Outcome variable type and pairing structure.

test.description: Exact statistical test from the NFR-8-compliant catalogue.

effectSize.description: Effect size measure paired with the test.

aggregationUnit.description: Primary aggregation unit, as a guard against pseudo-replication.

threats.description: Named validity threats and their mitigations for this design.

mitigation.description: How this template mitigates the threat.

protocolSkeleton.description: The YAML skeleton that the compiler fills when instantiating this template. Contains placeholders ({{param}}) that are replaced by parameter values. This is validated against the protocol schema when filled.
